rules.edgeUnit: Complete physical occurrence slots; shorter contained spans on the same bound line join to the complete occurrence, retaining ALL original census IDs/spans by input ref. Wrapped physical segments retain their one original identity. Evidence census file-row IDs are qualified by originalLine/expression, never invented edge IDs. Counts are scheduling slots; unique census IDs and file rows are reported separately.
rules.precedence: L12-10 whole-file preserve; closed class3; L12-7 roots; behavioral Step5; absent; remaining Step4. Intersections also reported independently.
rules.scope: L12-60: skills/prompts/instructions/task-spec prose plus maintained comments; source/render joins are explicit. Headerless plugin files own themselves under L12-58(3). Runtime/code/example strings retain Step 5 custody. L12-10 conventions stay literal.

**Correction.** An earlier statement in this project's discussion said that the bwrap confinement hides `.fgos/secrets.local.env` from workers. That was wrong. `docs/specs/confinement-authority.md` lists the file under the open limits as "secret, not blind" (section 9.2 closing paragraph), and the built-in `host-write-denied` policy has `hostRead: allow`. Read from the policy and the spec, a confined worker can read the file today. **This was not tested live.** A live probe is delivery step X1.
